title: Chinese surname record
description: One record of the Chinese Surnames Open Dataset (CC BY 4.0). Field names are English; free-text values are Chinese. Empty string and null both mean unknown — never zero.

surname.description: The surname in Chinese characters: one character, or two for a compound surname such as 欧阳.

slug.description: Tone-numbered pinyin, used as the site URL key. Also a tone-free join key: prefix-matching /^li/ catches li3, liang2, liao4, lin2, liu2.

era.description: Period in which the surname mainly took shape.

ancestor.description: Founding ancestor as recorded in the histories. Where the sources disagree, both readings are kept, separated by 、 — this is not a typo.

origin.description: Place of origin, given as a modern administrative location for join-ability.

junwang.description: Commanderies (郡望): regions where a branch of the clan rose to prominence. Lists the most frequently cited ones, not all.

tanghao.description: Hall names (堂号) with their derivations. In the CSV this is flattened to names only, joined by |.

note.description: How the hall name arose, in Chinese.

rank.description: National population rank as a display string, per the 2020 Ministry of Public Security national name report. Empty string when no official rank exists. Kept so the data matches what readers see on the site; use rank_num for sorting.

rank_num.description: The same rank as a number. null when unknown — never 0.

population.description: Population estimate as published. "人数稀少" means the surname is recorded as rare with no figure; empty string means unknown.

population_est.description: Population estimate in persons. null for both "人数稀少" and unknown — never filled with 0.

population_source.description: Provenance of population/population_est. mps2020 = figure printed verbatim in the 2020 MPS name report's compound-surname section (欧阳 111.2万, 令狐 5.5万 …); that report's top-100 table lists ranks but no headcounts, so no single-character surname carries this value. estimate = some other statistic or estimate, of varying vintage — not official. qualitative = only the remark 人数稀少, no figure. Empty = no data. Sort on rank_num, never on population_est: the two columns are not from the same survey and adjacent inversions exist.

origin_note.description: Prose account of how the surname came to exist, in Chinese. States competing branches in parallel instead of forcing a single root.
examples: 嬴姓。舜时皋陶任大理（掌刑狱），子孙以官为氏称「理」。……遂改「理」为「李」。

url.description: Full detail page for that surname on the site.
